name: Misty Reed Post
summary: Between Stagalbog and the Misty Reed Strand, Misty Reed Post keeps watch over the wetlands and the dangerous coast. The Horde holds this camp under Stonard's authority.

sections.title: A Lonely Outpost
sections.body: A handful of Stonard hunters, the shaman Katar, and Tok'Kar keep watch between Stagalbog and the eastern shore. The camp stands under Stonard's banner, exposed to marsh wildlife and lingering damp. Tok'Kar hopes Horde command in Stonard will send an orcish burrow or watchtower. For now, the scouts hold the marsh with tents, campfire smoke, and sharpened steel.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Misty Reed Post?
aliases: why is misty reed post here
faq.answer: Misty Reed Post is a forward camp for the Horde garrison at Stonard. Its sentries watch the coast and the swamp beasts between Stagalbog and the Misty Reed Strand.
Tok'Kar leads Misty Reed Post with Katar, a Stonard shaman, and several Stonard hunters. He hopes the camp will receive resources for permanent fortifications.

faq.q: Is there a flight master at Misty Reed Post?
aliases: is there a flight path here
faq.answer: No. Misty Reed Post has no wind rider facilities. Follow the road west to Stonard for flight paths.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can find shelter and local guidance here while scouting the marsh's dangerous eastern edge.
As a hunter, you share this post with Stonard hunters who know the surrounding marsh. Their work calls for grit as they track and survive its hostile wetland predators.
